description: Add up to 50 picks to one list in a single call, in order. Unlike add_item this never falls back to the Inbox: `list` must resolve to exactly one of the curator's lists or nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this reviewed batch. Reuse the same key and identical picks after a lost response.

items.description: Up to 50 picks, added in the order given.

author.description: Author or creator as the person gives it (books, articles, posts), e.g. from "Title - Author - why". Stored as the pick's author and never replaced by added details. Keep it out of the note.

note.description: The curator's own reason for recommending it. Stored verbatim and never AI-rewritten.

title.description: Item title. Required unless a url is given.

list.description: Which list: exact slug, handle/slug, or id from a previous result.

name: add_items
title: Add several picks
